description: Enemy ace squadrons in the spirit of Ace Combat and Project Wingman. Make enough noise and the enemy sends its best after you: a named squadron with an emblem, a cinematic intro and title card, radio chatter and music, flown by aces who use post-stall manoeuvres, jam, go dark, beam missiles and fire back over the shoulder. Threat gauge and squadron health bars on the HUD, a record with kill markings and medals, and handmade squadrons with your own emblems, music, voice lines, liveries and loadouts. UI Plus is recommended for the HUD integration.
